provenance.ACCURATE: 2026-10-17 same-GPU ordinary eager remeasurement, 3 blocks x120 samples, batch1 FP32. Mean measured compute + H2D + D2H once.
provenance.Fast: 2026-10-17 same-input ordinary eager remeasurement, no CUDA Graph. Full, Prefix/Head and contiguous inline chain measured. Effective suffix=rounded complete chain minus rounded Prefix/Head; not an isolated suffix benchmark.
provenance.Local: Reduced the full two-probe-plus-classifier total from 19.48ms to exactly 17.48ms. Each current Local stage scaled by 1748/1948 and rounded to integer ns; first-probe complete Local totals 15.865915ms. This is a chosen simulation service target, not a new physical camera measurement.
provenance.deadline: Fixed original generation+50ms for the 495000-task demand-transfer main experiment.
provenance.parameter_changes: Future GPU calibrations do not silently replace these locked simulation values; explicit change required. Raw historical measurements/results remain unchanged.
provenance.timing_scope: Same original 24 prepared inputs and batch1 sequential eager functions. GPU spans and paired host wall spans measured; H2D/D2H measured separately and included once in derived services. Excludes input preprocessing, network, queue and controller. No CUDA Graph, no policy simulation. Host wall contains event-record and completion synchronization overhead; it is reported separately, not added onto GPU spans. Simulation service uses the mean CUDA-event stage spans plus the mean measured transfers once; paired wall-clock spans are diagnostic, not another service surcharge. Effective contiguous suffix is rounded inline total minus rounded Prefix/Head.
